scored_by: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via scripts/rubric.mjs, two independent passes per asset (pass A on the 8x plain view, pass B on the debug sheet), re-scored after the Surface Resolution art changes

verdict.note: Re-score after applying light bands, tone roles and outline seams. Mean 3.71 against 4.0, with scene pass A cluster_discipline 2 — the bar is missed, so the track records the failure rather than lowering it. Sword and prop clear 4.0; the scene and humanoid do not.

silhouette.why: The distinct shape of a corked bottle with a bulbous body is clearly identifiable at 1x scale without color.

value_separation.why: The elements such as cork, liquid, and glass are mostly well separated, though some adjacent values blend closely.

lighting.why: The lighting generally implies a top-left source, but some highlights and shadow placements feel inconsistent across the separate masses.

edge_language.why: The outer outline is solid, but internal details and material boundaries lack a fully deliberate and varied edge treatment.

cluster_discipline.why: Most pixel groups form clean clusters with minimal noise, though some minor isolated pixels exist.

palette_craft.why: The color choices are coherent for a potion, but the ramps could step more evenly for better contrast and depth.
